name: qinghe-inventory-trace
description: 青禾库存追溯台 - 生鲜仓批次追溯系统

scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @qinghe/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @qinghe/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && PORT=3001 CLIENT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 npm run dev -w @qinghe/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001/api npm run dev -w @qinghe/client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @qinghe/server && npm run build -w @qinghe/client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c green,blue "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
